text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT: Streaming chunking stall detected — p99 spike on SSE/WebSocket responses in eu-west-1. Paging oncall.

alex: seeing repeated user reports of streams hanging around 18-30s, clients show no 5xx. p95 ~1.1s, p99 jumped to 28s. Anyone oncall? @oncall-liam

oncall-liam: on it. I'm pulling traces. Any recent deploys to streaming-proxy or gateway? :eyes:

mira: deploys: gateway v2.14 rolled 15m ago (traffic split 10%). streaming-proxy no deploys in last 6h. Kernel/userland unchanged.

jess: adding a note — we observed increased client slow-consumer backpressure last hour on a subset of connections, might be correlated.

paul: quick check — heartbeat mismatch logs around same time: 
```
[streaming-proxy] WARN client-slow-consumer id=xyz linger=18432ms write_queue=512
[streaming-proxy] INFO keepalive: last_pong=45s ago, initiating connection reset
```

alex: customers impacted: 2 enterprise customers in eu-west region reported stalled UIs. CS flagged one with degraded UX but no data loss. @cs-bot, can you confirm severity? 

cs-bot: Customer impact: degraded UX for customers acme-inc and beta-co; estimated 7% of active streams in eu-west experiencing stalls. Escalation requested.

oncall-liam: mounting tracer. Initial hypothesis: proxy write buffer fill => connection stalls => upstream runtime queue backlog. Steps: 1) verify proxy buffer metrics, 2) check keepalive/timeout thresholds, 3) route traffic to fallback pool if proxy saturated.

mira: metrics: proxy_outstanding_writes per instance spiked to 98% of configured queue on nodes sp-35..38. Also see socket write syscalls blocking for ~40ms each.

jess: can we toggle proxy write timeout to a lower threshold to fail fast? current `socket_write_timeout_ms=2000`. Suggest 500ms as temporary mitigation.

paul: agree. Also reduce http chunk buffer to force smaller frames: `max_chunk_bytes` from 64k -> 16k. That will increase CPU but reduce per-write latency.

oncall-liam: executing mitigations now.

oncall-liam: Ran rollout patch -> set socket_write_timeout_ms=500 on sp-35..38 and adjusted max_chunk_bytes=16384 at 11:07:21Z. Observing immediate drop in write_queue length on those nodes.

alex: logs after change:
```
[sp-35] INFO socket_write block 490ms -> forced reset
[sp-35] INFO connection reset and client reconnect attempt
```

mira: p99 dropped from 28s -> 6.8s within 3 minutes. p95 stable. Good signal.

jess: Can we do a graceful reroute for new sessions away from older pool? If sp-35..38 are healthy but overloaded historically, we should shift traffic to sp-20..24 which show lower avg latency.

paul: started traffic reweighting via traffic-router: incrementally moved 25% of new sessions off the problematic pool at 11:12Z.

oncall-liam: continuing watch. Notifying eng-runtime to look at KV cache locking in the runtime — heavy cache eviction could be increasing write amplification.

eng-runtime (alex): I see periodic KV store stalls around same timestamps with locks lasting 30-60ms, correlates with a GC pause on runtime-host-7. Scheduling a hotfix deploy for runtime to reduce GC pressure.

jess: also toggled websocket ping interval from 60s -> 15s for eu-west to detect slow consumers earlier.

mira: adding a temporary rule on the edge to reject connections with linger > 20s. That'll reduce stuck sockets but will increase reconnects; informing CS.

cs-bot: Notified acme-inc and beta-co support contacts about mitigation steps; they'll monitor. No escalations to legal/exec requested.

oncall-liam: current status: mitigations applied, metrics trending down. p99 ~6s, outstanding_writes at ~20%. Keeping incident open for 2hr monitoring and a postmortem. Handoff to day shift @alex @mira.

alex: will pick up long-term fix: investigate why proxy write syscall blocks so long — likely kernel-level socket buffer exhaustion combined with slow TCP consumers. Plan: instrument TCP buffers and consider pacing/tcp_nodelay tuning.

paul: follow-ups: 1) full postmortem, 2) telemetry to detect slow consumer earlier via keepalive metrics, 3) evaluate chunking defaults (maybe 16k permanent?), 4) runtime GC tuning and cache lock profiling.

jess: thumbs up. I'll draft the mitigation timeline and config diffs.

oncall-liam: final note: incident-bot will create incident ticket INC-2026-139 and page rotation for oncall handoff at 13:00Z. If regressions occur revert config changes with rollback playbook.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident status updated -> mitigation applied. Ticket INC-2026-139 created. Resolution target: monitoring window 2h.
